While previous studies on base p/q systems focus on evaluating words that translate to nonnegative integers, our analysis examines subsets of (Np/q)d that are recognizable through finite automata in one or two dimensions for d equals 1 and 2. AR at the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics in Germany features a complex magnetic field configuration, making it relevant for plasma devices with varying magnetic topology.
